content: An interesting side-effect we have observed is the model's resilience to code-switching in the input text. The reason is that the model is trained with only the target language (and domain), and not the source language, as a result of which it learns language normalization of sorts. For example, the sentence “Ma tahan two saldējumus.” (“Ma tahan” / “I want” in Estonian, “two” and “saldējumus” / “ice-creams” in genitive, plural in Latvian) is correctly translated into English as “I want two ice creams.”. See more examples in Appendix SECREF8 .
